correctness.rationale: At a disk of squared radius x>0, the Fock localization eigenvalues λ_j=1−e^(−x)sum_{a=0}^j x^a/a! are strictly decreasing, isolating rank-N cluster. A rank-one coherent-state Bochner boundary integral is C² in trace norm for small mean-zero C² perturbations r²=x+epsilon h. Isolated cluster second derivative cancels internal-pair terms; the cross-cluster denominator λ_i−λ_j=e^(−x)sum_{a=i+1}^j p_a yields the explicit Γ_{N,k} Fourier multiplier. k=1 cancels, k=2 gives p_{N−1}(N+1+2x)/((N+x)(N+1+x))>0; all Γ>=0 also follows from Abreu known global disk inequality. For fixed k and x=N, adjacent Poisson-weight expansion plus exact finite sums yields NΓ/p_{N−1}→(k²−1)/4, and Stirling gives the N^(−3/2) norm and Jacobi form for fixed trigonometric-polynomial h with epsilon first. Independently checked rational Γ1, Γ2 for N=2..9, x=1/3,1,5/2 and k=1..19 finite polynomial identities; finite numerics not infinite proof.
